verdict.rationale: Datalab explicitly documents JSON-schema-based structured extraction: 'Extract specific fields from documents by providing a JSON schema. Marker parses the document and fills in your schema with extracted values' via a dedicated /extract API, with support for citations back to source bounding boxes and checkpoint reuse from prior conversions. This is a first-class, well-documented feature with SDK and API support. Missing for 10: independent hands-on validation of extraction accuracy/schema fidelity beyond vendor docs.
